close_reason: All six child tickets are implemented, reviewed, verified, closed, and published as draft stack #142
description:
## Goal
Adopt the Elixir-shaped named-function surface completely: public clauses use def, private clauses use defp, both lex as ordinary identifiers and reach the existing macro -> Fz.Compiler.define -> typed-definition pipeline. fn remains only the reserved anonymous-function opener. fnp ceases to be language syntax.

## Output contract
For `def quicksort([pivot | rest]) when guard, do: body`, the front door produces the same structural shape as Elixir: `def` is a normal two-argument call, its first argument is a `when` node wrapping the callable head, and its second argument is `[do: body]`. The definition macros capture the caller environment, grouped clauses publish one FunctionSource, def is exported, and defp is not. No Def, Defp, or Fnp lexer token exists.

## Signal
1. Parser tests compare FZ quoted structure with checked-in Elixir `Code.string_to_quoted` shapes for ordinary, guarded, zero-arity, operator-headed, nested-do, protocol, and macro-generated definitions.
2. Production-path fixture tests cover run, interp, and build, plus interface privacy, forward references, clause grouping, redefinition/retraction, __ENV__/__CALLER__, and diagnostics for retired fn/fnp named forms.
3. A static removal census rejects dedicated Def/Defp/Fnp tokens, fn/fnp definition macros or recognized definition heads, old named-definition source spellings, and stale user documentation.
4. Full workspace tests, fixture matrix, docs tests, fmt, check, and clippy with warnings denied are green.

## Strategy
Work from the quoted output contract downward. First make when and trailing-do ownership general expression grammar, because ordinary identifier parsing otherwise cannot form the Elixir AST. Then teach the existing quoted definition accumulator and compiler-definition macros the def/defp heads without lexer support. Migrate the entire source corpus while both old and new entry points are temporarily available. Finally delete named fn/fnp grammar and every compatibility path.

## Elixir authority
- `elixir_tokenizer.erl`: def/defp are identifiers; fn is a reserved terminator and when is a reserved operator.
- `elixir_parser.yrl`: when is a generic right-associative operator weaker than :: and =; matched/unmatched no-parens productions assign a trailing do block to the outer call.
- `Kernel.def/defp`: macros call one shared define implementation with __CALLER__.
- `elixir_def.erl`: extracts guards from the received head, validates kind/name/arity, accumulates clauses by name/arity, and establishes the function expansion environment.
- `elixir_erl.erl`: def contributes an export; defp contributes code but no export.

## Existing FZ authority to reuse
Keep the one-read source model and macro bounce established by fz-s00. Extend `quoted_surface` grouping, reserved-name discovery, `Fz.Compiler.define`, FunctionForm privacy, lazy FunctionSource expansion, ScopeSnapshot environment projection, and existing telemetry. Do not add a second definition parser or backend privacy mechanism.

## Deliberate removals
Delete Tok::Fnp and its token payload support; remove fn/fnp from named item, protocol callback, extern, runtime macro, definition-head, reservation, grouping, fixture-discovery, and documentation paths. Preserve Tok::Fn solely for anonymous `fn ... -> ... end`. Supersede rather than merge the lexer-alias implementation on fz-5xp.7 / PR #129.

## Construction scaffolding
The middle migration step temporarily accepts both surfaces only so every commit remains green. That coexistence is not a shipped design and is owned by the final deletion ticket; the epic is incomplete until the deletion census passes.

comments.text: Design correction from review: do not describe current guard handling as reconstruction. It is duplicate grammar authority: the ordinary expression parser stops before when, then named-function, case, and anonymous-clause readers independently parse and manufacture guard nodes. fz-6lf.1 is complete only when precedence and binary when construction have one expression-level owner; clause code may package an already-parsed multi-argument anonymous head but may not decide when syntax or precedence.

title: Elixir definition surface: def/defp are macros, fn is anonymous-only, fnp is gone
